Posted December 18, 2000
(MarijuanaNews note: This has been in the works for months. Nonetheless, it is astonishingly arrogant and illegal act.
See
Drug Czar Seeks To Ban All Hemp Products
and
Drug Czar Intervenes To Stop Importation of Hemp Products With Any Trace of THC.

The timing is clearly intended to be an end-run around the usual review process, which makes it all the more outrageous. I told a friend in the hemp business today that -- while I am very sorry for those who will be hurt by this stupidity – this action may actually help the anti-prohibitionist movement, precisely because it is so stupid and arbitrary.

Although Representative Thielen does not specifically mention hemp seed oil as a nutritional supplement, that is the one hemp product that will be most impacted by the ban.

The " good news " is that this fact will put the DEA on a collision course with the powerful health food industry. Hemp seed oil is an invaluable supplement for some people.)


From Cynthia Thielen thielen@aloha.net
Assistant Republican Floor Leader
Hawaii House of Representatives
December 15, 2000

(MarijuanaNews note: The Thielen family has been at the forefront of the Hawaiian hemp movement.)

See
Reports from Hawaii on Attempts to Get State Approval for Hemp Cultivation
and
Hawaii Authorizes Industrial Hemp Seed Variety Trials.
"...DEA will consider setting the level of THC content for Cannabis Sativa L., hemp
that may be grown for industrial purposes. "
and
Hawaiian Paper Gives Favorable Report On State Representative Thielen’s Federal Hemp Petition

Subject: DEA regulations

I have just heard that DEA intends to publish its new regulations in the Federal Register before the new Bush Administration takes over. Evidently agencies sometimes do this to get their regulatory changes into effect before the next president takes over.

The regulations will be devastating to the efforts to legalize industrial hemp in the USA. The regulations also will seriously impact or actually kill products made with industrial hemp which are intended for human consumption. This will include hemp lip balm, any hemp products which could be used to soothe nose/sinus, or anything that DEA claims could be " ingested. "

I also understand that the regulations will put a cloud over hemp body care products, saying if the shampoo or lotion user tests positive for THC, then the products will be outlawed.

DEA chose the time when people are celebrating the holidays and when Congress will be in recess to do this. Please fight back now to keep these regulations from being published.

Write and call Janet Reno to object. Do the same to Pres. Clinton. And if you have established some relationship with a member of Congress on this subject, contact him/her as soon as possible. One approach is to say these regs should be tabled to let the next administration decide.

For you in the hemp industry/businesses, please stress the economic disaster which will hit U.S. businesses if they publish these regulations. And if you know your governor, ask him/her to contact President Bill Clinton immediately to stop DEA from publishing.

This isn't much of a Christmas message--sorry. But I guess we should have expected this tactic from DEA/McCaffrey.
See
Some Hemp Producers In Limbo After Reversal of DEAland Hempseed Import Rules Says Canadian Agricultural Magazine
and
Woody Harrelson Acquitted of Marijuana Possession for Planting 4 Hemp Seeds in Kentucky As DEA Invades Oglala Sioux Reservation and Cuts Down Hemp Crop. Special to MarijuanaNews
and
 " False Evidence " Is The Foundation Of Marijuana Prohibition,
Not Just One Hawaiian Hemp Seed Case

Let's get to work! (Please distribute this to your lists.)
See
Hemp Movement Uses The Internet:
" We knew we’d have to grow the word before we could grow the crop. "

Aloha,
Rep. Cynthia Thielen
Assistant Republican Floor Leader
Hawaii House of Representatives
